name: 30947-eagledecode-8b-tp4
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct as the target, with lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B as the EAGLE (v1) draft head. The target is an ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct; the Meta Llama 3 Community License applies.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: Target LlamaForCausalLM: 32 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, served float16 and sharded TP4. Draft LlamaForCausalLMEagle: one decoder layer, hidden 4096, float16, max_position_embeddings 2048.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 480 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix structure, seed 42. Prompts a fixed 512 tokens, generations a fixed 1024 tokens, with `temperature: 0` and `ignore_eos: true` so every request generates its full length.
purpose: A long-form article assistant on an eight-billion-parameter model with a draft model, serving eight concurrent users across four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang launch arguments. Flat `key: value` only.

# An ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct (Meta Llama 3 Community License).
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 4

# fp16 rather than the target checkpoint's native bf16: the draft head below is an fp16
# checkpoint trained in fp16, and moving it off its training precision changes what it predicts.
dtype: float16

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 5
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 6

attention-backend: fa3

# Forced, not tuned: the draft head declares max_position_embeddings 2048, and sglang otherwise
# overrides the draft's context length with the target's 8192, which raises unless
# SGLANG_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN=1. The workload never exceeds 512 + 1024 tokens.
context-length: 2048

random-seed: 42
